en.topic_title: Hong Kong fertility clinic allowed to fully resume services after investigation into embryo sample mix-up
en.topic_summary:
A fertility clinic has been allowed to fully resume its services following an embryo sample mix-up incident earlier this year, Hong Kong authorities have announced.



Ex-financial secretary Antony Leung (third from left), one of the founders of Heal Fertility, attends an opening ceremony for the centre in 2023. Photo: Heal Medical Group.
